manifest:
schema_version = "1.0.0"
id = "cloth_next"
version = "2.9.22"
name = "Cloth NeXt"
tagline = "High-fidelity cloth and soft-body simulation"
maintainer = "Tim Christmann"
type = "add-on"
website = "https://github.com/polyworks-art/Cloth_neXT"
tags = ["Physics"]
blender_version_min = "5.0.0"
license = ["SPDX:GPL-3.0-or-later"]
copyright = ["2026 Tim Christmann and Cloth NeXt contributors"]
platforms = ["windows-x64", "linux-x64"]

[permissions]
network = "Download explicitly selected external solver dependencies"
files = "Manage the separate solver installation outside the extension"

[build]
paths_exclude_pattern = ["__pycache__/", "*.pyc", ".*", "/*.zip", "*.blend[1-9]", "resources/.state/"]
